video:video.video:title: Toyota Cheated So Well, the FIA Called It Genius
video:video.video:description: How Toyota Team Europe hid an illegal turbo restrictor in the 1995 World Rally Championship, in the Celica GT-Four ST205, and why FIA president Max Mosley called it genius. Toyota was leading both world championships with two rallies left. Then scrutineers at Rally Catalunya took Auriol's car apart.

video:video.video:title: Ferrari vs Lamborghini: The Insult That Started It All
video:video.video:description: Ferruccio Lamborghini was a tractor maker who drove Ferraris. When the clutch kept failing, he went to Maranello to complain, and Enzo Ferrari supposedly told him he'd never handle a Ferrari. This is the full Lamborghini vs Ferrari origin story.

video:video.video:title: Porsche Bought a Nissan to Prove It Cheated. It Backfired.
video:video.video:description: In 2008 Porsche bought a Nissan GT-R, flew it to Germany, lapped the Nürburgring and accused Nissan of cheating with race tyres. Nissan's reply: maybe Porsche's drivers needed lessons. This is the full GT-R vs Porsche 911 Turbo story.

video:video.video:title: Toyota Lost Money on Every Lexus LFA. Owners Didn't.
video:video.video:description: In 2010, Toyota sold the Lexus LFA for $375,000 and still lost money on every single one. Today one has sold for $1.81 million. Here's the full story of Toyota's craziest supercar.

video:video.video:title: Why Ferrari FEARED This Honda | Honda NSX Story
video:video.video:description: The full Honda NSX (Acura NSX) history: how Ayrton Senna called Honda's secret supercar "fragile" at Suzuka in 1989, and how Honda answered with an aluminium body, a VTEC V6 and a chassis 50% stiffer, the car that woke up Ferrari.

video:video.video:title: The AE86 Wasn't Fast. So Why Is It a Legend?
video:video.video:description: The full Toyota AE86 history: how a slow, cheap 1983 Corolla became the Hachi-Roku legend behind Initial D and drifting. It was never fast, so why does everyone still want one?

video:video.video:title: Mazda's Rotary Engine Should Never Have Worked (RX-7 & 787B Story)
video:video.video:description: The Mazda rotary engine has no pistons. It drinks fuel, burns oil, and nearly bankrupted Mazda, yet it won Le Mans with the 787B and powered the RX-7. So why do people love the rotary so much?

video:video.video:title: Why the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 Was Banned in America (Godzilla's Full Story)
video:video.video:description: Why was the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 banned in the USA, and is the R34 finally legal to import in 2026? For 25 years Americans could only drive Godzilla in Gran Turismo. This is the complete R34 GT-R history: from the 1969 Hakosuka to the R32 that earned the "Godzilla" nickname, the RB26DETT twin-turbo engine, the 25-year import rule and the $1.357 million Paul Walker R34 auction.

video:video.video:title: The Toyota Supra Mk4: How Toyota Built a Legend
video:video.video:description: How did a Japanese sports coupe from 1993 become one of the most wanted cars on the planet? From the 1967 Toyota 2000GT to the first Celica Supra, chief engineer Isao Tsuzuki's "less is more" Mk4, and the legendary 2JZ-GTE with its sequential twin turbos, this is the full story of the A80 Toyota Supra.
